mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 4.5% in a month coincides with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to tightened financing conditions affecting corporate investment.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% in a single month
regime_hint: tightening cycle after a period of easing
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 30 consecutive days, or no significant correlation (p > 0.05) between FEDFUNDS spikes and negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment (UNRATE) below 4.5% for two consecutive months predicts a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as investor sentiment deteriorates amid labor market weakness.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.5% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive when UNRATE < 4.5%, or UNRATE remains above 4.5% for 4 months with no negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST (units of housing starts) by at least 5% above the prior month's level precedes a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals renewed construction activity and economic momentum.
candidate_trigger: HOUST monthly growth > 5% over prior month
failure_condition: No significant positive 20-day returns when HOUST growth > 5%, or returns are negative despite the signal in 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO (index of industrial production) by 2% or more over three months indicates softening supply-side activity, which is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: INDPRO recovers >2% in 3 months without reversal in forward returns, or 20-day returns are positive during the contraction.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises by 0.25% in a single month while CPIAUCSL remains flat, the S&P 500 is expected to deliver a positive 5-day forward return as the rate hike is perceived as less inflationary.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >0.25% while CPIAUCSL shows no increase in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day returns are negative despite the described FEDFUNDS/CPIAUCSL pattern, or the interaction term is insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in PAYEMS (number of payroll jobs) by 100,000 or more in a month coincides with a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as job market weakness erodes confidence.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS falls by >100,000 in a single month
failure_condition: Payrolls recover by <50,000 in the following month without reversal in 60-day returns, or 60-day returns are positive during the drop.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of RSAFS (retail sales) exceeding 1% above trend are associated with a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals resilient consumer demand.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS monthly growth > 1% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: RSAFS remains flat or declines for 3 months with no positive 20-day returns during the upswing.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE remains above 5% for two consecutive months in a deflationary regime, the S&P 500 shows a negative 60-day forward return due to persistent labor market stress and weak demand.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5% for 2 consecutive months in deflationary regime
failure_condition: UNRATE falls below 5% without a subsequent positive 60-day forward return, or returns are positive during the high-unemployment period.
